@@U01072@@
(Enter 梅菲斯特.)

@@U01073@@
Listen, I want you to get me that girl!

@@U01075@@
Girl? Which girl?

@@U01077@@
She just passed by.

@@U01079@@
Oh, her! Yes, well, I mean,
she’s just come from confession, you know.
The priest absolved her of her sins,
every last one, no less.
I crept up close to hear and, well—
she’s an innocent, a young thing
with nothing to confess.
How could I have power over her?

@@U01081@@
She’s over fourteen, isn’t she?

@@U01083@@
Ah! There!
The down-and-dirty libertine speaks!
Your kind believes every blossom
blows for him alone; you flatter yourself
that there’s no honor or favor
that isn’t yours for the reaping.
It’s just that things don’t always fall out that way.

@@U01085@@
I suggest to you, Most Mighty Master Moralist,
that you come down off your pulpit
and spare me your sermons.
And let me be brief and to the point. Either
that sweet lovely thing is in my arms tonight,
or at midnight you and I are quits.
translation:
@@U01072@@
（梅菲斯特上。）

@@U01073@@
听着，我要你给我找那个女孩！

@@U01075@@
女孩？哪个女孩？

@@U01077@@
她刚刚路过。

@@U01079@@
哦，她！是的，嗯，我的意思是，
你知道，她刚刚告白。
神父赦免了她的罪孽，
每最后一个都不能少。
我蹑手蹑脚地凑近去听，然后——
她是一个天真无邪的年轻人
没有什么可承认的。
我怎么可能对她有权力？

@@U01081@@
她已经十四岁了，不是吗？

@@U01083@@
啊！那里！
下流的浪荡子居然敢说话！
你的同类相信每一朵花
为他一人而吹；你自吹自擂
没有荣誉或恩惠
那不是你的收获。
只是事情并不总是那样。

@@U01085@@
我向您建议，最强大的道德大师，
你从讲坛上下来
别再给我讲道了。
让我简明扼要地讲一下。要么
今晚那个甜蜜可爱的东西就在我怀里，
或者在午夜你和我都退出了。
